about.text: A small fresh cheese made mainly in Stella, between Imperia and Savona in Liguria, usually from goat's milk. The milk is set with liquid rennet at 16 to 24 °C over 8 to 24 hours, the curd is drained in perforated bowls and salted by hand, and it is ready to eat after about 12 hours.
